subject: Window size of JGR on startup

messages.author: 942a80e5239ef482
messages.subject: Window size of JGR on startup
parts:
Hello All,

I am using JGR and deducer on a really small screen (netbook, 1024x600). When I open up JGR, the height of the window is more than my screen and the console is just about not visible. How can I start off JGR in a smaller window?

I have looked at JGREditorprefsrc, it has an entry "consoleHeight" which I modified to "400", it was previously set to "650" but the GUI still opened at what I think is "650".

Could someone here please help. I am quite stuck and need to demonstrate some analysis I have done to my Prof. in a few days.

I know this is a Deducer group, but the close integration of Deducer with JGR leads me to think that someone here might have faced the problem. JGR's bugzilla is down.

Thanks again and sorry if this topic is off topic. 

Regards,
Mohammad Haris Minai

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Window size of JGR on startup
parts:
The JGR console's minimum size is 555 by 650, so you can't make it any
smaller than that. The only solution is to edit the JGR source and
rebuild (line 237 of JGRConsole.java).

ian
